height_determination.question: How is component height determined?
height_determination.answer: Parent sets bounds via resized(). desiredHeight_ is tracked (line 486, 512) but component uses getHeight(). Layout reserves 30px for transport buttons above rows.

resized_layout.question: How does resized() work end-to-end?
resized_layout.answer: resized() (line 552-720) positions all UI elements. It calculates effective widths, positions transport buttons ABOVE rows at Y = rowContentTopY() - transportBtnH - 4

y_ranges.y: rowContentTopY() - 26 (line 593) - positioned above where rows start
rowContentTopY() (line 609) - this is the START of all rows

rowContentTopY_details.question: How does rowContentTopY() work exactly?
rowContentTopY_details.answer: Reserves 30px strip for transport buttons, then centers rows below it within available height. MINIMUM RETURN is transportStripH (30px)

key_lines: 1496: const int transportStripH = 30;  // Reserve space for play/stop buttons above rows

paint_row_rendering.question: How does paint() draw rows? What Y offset?
paint_row_rendering.answer: paint() (line 291-550) uses topMargin = rowContentTopY() (line 305). Applies scrollY_ offset. NO clipping regions used - relies on paint() clip boundaries

evidence.content: g.fillRect(juce::Rectangle<int>(area.getX(), topMargin + hoverRow_ * rowHeight - scrollY_, contentW - effRightW, rowHeight));
const int lineYOffset = line * numChannels * rowHeight; ... g.fillRect(juce::Rectangle<int>(x, area.getY() + topMargin + lineYOffset, 1, lineHeight));

cellBounds_calculation.question: How does cellBounds() calculate positions?
cellBounds_calculation.answer: cellBounds() (line 1452-1478) uses rowContentTopY() for topMargin, applies scrollY_ offset for Y, uses bar-wrapping logic for X positioning

key_calculation: 1464-1465: const int lineIndex = step / stepsPerLine; const int stepWithinLine = step % stepsPerLine;
1475-1476: const int visualRow = lineIndex * numChannels + row; const int y = area.getY() + topMargin + visualRow * rowHeight - scrollY_ + (rowHeight - cellSize) / 2;

retracted_vs_expanded.question: Retracted vs expanded state?
retracted_vs_expanded.answer: Not a true retracted state. Component uses labelsCollapsed_ and rightPanelCollapsed_ flags. Left/right panels can be hidden. Height is always parent-determined.

evidence.content: bool labelsCollapsed_ = false; bool rightPanelCollapsed_ = false;

transport_button_positioning.question: Where should transport buttons be positioned?
transport_button_positioning.answer: ALREADY POSITIONED CORRECTLY (lines 582-597)! Buttons are centered above rows, starting at Y = rowContentTopY() - 26. NO CHANGES NEEDED.

details: Line 593: const int transportY = rowContentTopY() - transportBtnH - 4;
Line 595-596: playBtn_ and stopBtn_ positioned at transportY

rowContentTopY_modification.question: Does rowContentTopY() need to change?
rowContentTopY_modification.answer: NO. rowContentTopY() already reserves 30px for transport buttons (line 1496). Component does NOT need to request more height - parent controls that.

architecture.height_control: Parent component controls getHeight() - sets via setBounds()
architecture.transport_reserve: rowContentTopY() guarantees minimum 30px above first row
architecture.centering: Rows are centered below transport strip within available height
architecture.scrolling: Vertical scroll applied ONLY to rows, not transport area

vertical_layout.buttons: Play/Stop centered horizontally, positioned at Y = rowContentTopY() - 26

vertical_layout.note: Rows may be vertically centered if component height > content height

key_constant.name: transportStripH
key_constant.purpose: Reserve space above rows for play/stop buttons

if_adding_new_buttons_above_transport.recommendation: Modify rowContentTopY() to reserve more than 30px (e.g., 60px) and adjust line 1496 constant

recommendations.architecture_pattern: All Y coordinates derive from rowContentTopY() - this is the single source of truth for vertical layout
